articles.title: Printing New Body Parts? It’s Already Happening!
articles.summary: Scientists are using 3-D printers and living cells to build skin, cartilage, and even blood vessels. In 2025, a robot printed a patient’s own skin cells directly onto her burns. How cool is that?

articles.title: 5,300-Year-Old Iceman Has Tiny Living Passengers!
articles.summary: Ötzi the Iceman’s body still carries living yeasts from the glacier where he died 5,300 years ago. Scientists found these cold-loving microbes on his skin and inside his stomach—and they might even be useful for industry.

articles.title: Stuck Together in Antarctica: What Happens When You Can’t Get Away?
articles.summary: Twelve people spent 10 months at a remote Antarctic station—and scientists tracked their every move. The surprising finding? More time together didn’t make them happier; it often led to more fights and less trust.
